topics.label: Free tier monetization and subscription creep
topics.description: Users are frustrated that the free version is increasingly limited: many workouts are locked behind a subscription, ads and premium pop-ups interrupt use, and formerly free or ad-supported features now require payment.

topics.label: Unexpected charges and cancellation problems
topics.description: Users report being charged immediately after signing up for free trials or after cancelling, and struggle to cancel subscriptions or get support.

topics.label: Workout quality, variety, and motivation
topics.description: Satisfied users praise the range of workouts, easy-to-follow routines, short flexible options, and motivational content that help them stay active.

topics.label: Technical and account access problems
topics.description: Some users cannot download workouts even after paying, get logged out and cannot restore access, or have no way to manage subscriptions and contact support.

candidates.label: Paywall and subscription creep
candidates.description: Long-time users say the app started free or ad-supported but now requires a subscription for most workouts, including previously saved plans.
candidates.quote: hate how they kept going from completely free to charging for everything now

candidates.label: Unexpected charges and cancellation problems
candidates.description: Users report being charged immediately after signing up for a free trial, charged after cancelling, and unable to cancel or get support.
candidates.quote: you told me a free trial for a week and the charged me $19.99 right away. what can i do?!

candidates.label: Free version too restrictive or unaffordable
candidates.description: Free users say too many workouts are locked behind payment, ask for more free options, and mention they cannot afford a subscription.
candidates.quote: i am on the free version and there are a lot of things that i can't do without paying

candidates.label: Aggressive ads and premium pop-ups
candidates.description: Users describe a frustrating free tier in which ads interrupt access and pop-ups push the paid version, sometimes with no way to continue.
candidates.quote: the workout is available with ads yet the interface traps you with their predatory ads.

candidates.label: Loved for workout variety, quality, and motivation
candidates.description: Satisfied reviewers praise the workout selection, easy-to-follow routines, short flexible options, and motivational content that help them stay active.
candidates.quote: this app has everything you need to get in shape and be healthy. very easy to follow good music and great workouts. highly recommended.

candidates.label: Technical and account access problems
candidates.description: Some users cannot download workouts even after paying, get logged out and cannot restore access, or find no way to manage subscriptions and contact support.
candidates.quote: even with a paid subscription, you cannot download. no help or steps from online searches help.
